scripts.db:check: node --env-file-if-exists=.env --input-type=module -e "const { Pool } = await import('pg'); if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL) throw new Error('DATABASE_URL obrigatória'); const p = new Pool({ connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL, connectionTimeoutMillis: 5000 }); try { await p.query('SELECT 1'); console.log('PostgreSQL disponível'); } finally { await p.end(); }"
